item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-239ce64b2085ef43","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On 4 May 2023, Brazil's Federal Audit Court (TCU) ordered the Navy, Air Force, and Army commands to provide procurement-system data and access for an audit of the regularity, risks, and controls of overseas military acquisitions conducted from 2018 to 2022; the decision allowed individually justified alternative access only for genuinely sensitive strategic data.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7","7B.6","7B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The audit decision occurred during 2023, but examined procurement practices from 2018–2022 and does not by itself establish Lula's personal direction or the audit's final findings.","ruler_attribution":"The TCU initiated and ordered the audit; the source does not attribute the decision personally to Lula.","limitations":["The supplied document reports the audit order and access requirements, not the eventual audit conclusions or any corrective action by the executive."]},{"source_id":"SRC-931ad13350dba4cc","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"On 5 December 2023, the World Bank approved a US$300 million project to strengthen Brazil's Bolsa Família conditional cash-transfer program, targeting approximately 9 million children aged zero to six in eligible households. The renewed design restored school-attendance, vaccination, and child-health-check requirements suspended during the pandemic, and set a transfer of R$150 per month for each participating child aged zero to six.","question_ids":["6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The financing approval and program design are dated December 2023; the source describes intended beneficiaries and mechanisms, not completed outcome results during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The project was approved by the World Bank and described by Brazil's Social Development Minister as supporting a federal-government priority; the source does not document Lula's personal decision or implementation management.","limitations":["The source is a World Bank press release and reports planned support and design features rather than independently measured 2023 effects."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-69abe257cdda46be","SRC-55bcd92ae1a5d1d7","SRC-3f5762d1c099c417","SRC-e2a2d8ef4c7d841f","SRC-1b5afc850944c64a","SRC-35eafdb3676b1e7b","SRC-20a3ce26f1624c25","SRC-70fb2a2df8b4a1f8","SRC-93919d21a8b43ecc","SRC-9d3744c12c659789"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied pages contained only navigation or metadata and no substantive article text. The fake-news documents describe legislative proposals and statements by senators or judicial officials, without a concrete Lula action. The supplied SciELO item reports 2024 outcomes in an article published in 2026, outside the target period."]}
